summary: Marchex, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 12, 2026, reporting entry into a Stock Purchase Agreement to acquire 100% of Archenia, Inc. for $10 million in convertible promissory notes (6% interest, convertible at $1.80/share) plus earn-out consideration of up to 4 million shares of Marchex Class B common stock tied to revenue/EBITDA and integration targets. A Special Committee approved the deal, with Craig-Hallum providing a fairness opinion and DLA Piper as legal counsel. Closing requires disinterested stockholder approval and is expected early Q3 2026. Watch for stockholder vote timing and earn-out targets.
